issues.problem: The mirror is offset to the left of the sink, with no overlap between their widths. Someone standing at the basin cannot look straight ahead into it.
issues.fix: Move the mirror along the wall to centre it above the sink, adjusting nearby wall lighting if needed.

issues.fix: Lower the holder beside the toilet so the paper-dispensing point is comfortably reachable from the seat, typically around 0.6–0.75 m above the floor.
